newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor down on speculative offerings.
newsitem.headline: India castor down on speculative offerings.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery dropped to 1,169/1,170 rupees per quintal from 1,175/1,176 rupees on fresh speculative offerings at the higher level on Wednesday, dealers said.

Fresh overseas buying turned sluggish at the higher level while improved supplies prompted profit-taking by bulls. There was no trading in the December delivery, traded at 1,181/1,182 rupees per quintal on Tuesday.
Castorseed arrivals in Gujarat rose to 10,000/12,000 bags (75 kg each) against the recent average of 4,000/5,000.
Groundnut oil moved up by 3/4 rupees at 378/380 rupees per 10 kg on the back of seasonal buying for approaching festivals.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil dropped to 588/590 rupees per 15 kg from 595 rupees. Arrivals in the Rajkot market improved due to clear weather after recent rains.

In Bombay imported palm-oil rose by 2 rupees at 258/259 rupees per 10 kg on outstation buying as well as a recovery in the world market. Sentiment at the close remained subdued as traders were expect more arrivals of imported palm-oil at Bombay port in the coming days.
